criterion_descriptions: Information must be taken from the NIST Chemistry WebBook record for water corresponding to the context URL (ID=C7732185). Full credit if the agent clearly uses that record OR if the agent attempts to access it but the page is inaccessible (blocked, down, CAPTCHA) and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if the agent uses NIST WebBook but provenance is ambiguous. No credit if values are clearly from non-NIST sources or a different substance/record when the specified record was accessible.

Report all four identity fields exactly as displayed in the specified NIST record: formula, molecular weight, IUPAC InChIKey, and CAS Registry Number. Full credit if all four are present and match the record (no altered punctuation/spacing). Partial credit if 1–3 fields are correct, or if minor transcription errors occur due to page rendering/visibility issues that the agent explicitly notes. No credit if most fields are missing/incorrect or correspond to a different compound.

Extract the CODATA experimental gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation entry (not calculated; not liquid-phase) from the specified NIST record, including (a) the numeric value with uncertainty exactly as shown, (b) the unit exactly as shown, and (c) the cited reference wording exactly as displayed. Full credit if all components are included verbatim and correspond to the CODATA experimental gas-phase entry. If the CODATA entry is not visible due to access/formatting limitations outside the agent’s control, full credit is awarded if the agent clearly reports the limitation and does not substitute non-CODATA/non-experimental/non-gas-phase values; partial credit if some components (e.g., reference) are missing despite being visible.

Preserve identifiers, numbers, uncertainty notation, units, and reference wording exactly as displayed when visible, and stop after the five required outputs (four identity fields plus the enthalpy entry including unit and reference). Full credit if transcription is exact and no extra unrequested content is added. Partial credit if minor extra content is included or if exact reproduction is impeded by visibility/rendering issues that the agent explicitly notes. No credit if substantial paraphrasing alters values/wording, or if the response materially continues beyond the stopping condition.
